1.text: Ariko Sawuli akomeza gukangisha abigishwa b'Umwami ko bicwa, ajya ku mutambyi mukuru

2.text: amusaba inzandiko zo guha ab'amasinagogi y'i Damasiko, kugira ngo nabona abantu b'Inzira ya Yesu, abagabo cyangwa abagore, ababohe abajyane i Yerusalemu.

3.text: Akigenda yenda gusohora i Damasiko, umucyo uramutungura uvuye mu ijuru uramugota.

4.text: Agwa hasi yumva ijwi rimubaza riti “Sawuli, Sawuli, undenganiriza iki?”

5.text: Aramubaza ati “Uri nde, Mwami?”Na we ati “Ndi Yesu, uwo urenganya.

6.text: Ariko haguruka ujye mu mudugudu, uzabwirwa ibyo ukwiriye gukora.”

7.text: Abagabo bajyanye na we bahagarara badakoma, kuko bumvise iryo jwi batagize umuntu babona.

8.text: Sawuli arabyuka arambuye amaso ntiyagira icyo areba, baramurandata bamujyana i Damasiko.

9.text: Amarayo gatatu atareba, atarya kandi atanywa.

10.text: I Damasiko hari umwigishwa witwaga Ananiya. Umwami Yesu aramubonekera aramuhamagara ati “Ananiya.”Na we ati “Karame, Mwami.”

11.text: Umwami aramubwira ati “Haguruka ujye mu nzira yitwa Igororotse, ushakire mu nzu ya Yuda umuntu witwa Sawuli w'i Taruso, kuko ubu ngubu asenga.

12.text: Kandi na we abonye mu iyerekwa umuntu witwa Ananiya yinjira, amurambikaho ibiganza kugira ngo ahumuke.”

13.text: Ananiya aramusubiza ati “Mwami, uwo muntu numvise benshi bamuvuga, uko yagiriraga nabi abera bawe bari i Yerusalemu,

14.text: kandi n'ino afite ubutware abuhawe n'abatambyi bakuru, bwo kuboha abāmbaza izina ryawe.”

15.text: Umwami aramusubiza ati “Genda kuko uwo muntu ari igikoreshwa nitoranirije, ngo yogeze izina ryanjye imbere y'abanyamahanga n'abami n'Abisirayeli,

16.text: nanjye nzamwereka ibyo azababazwa na we uburyo ari byinshi, bamuhora izina ryanjye.”

17.text: Ananiya aragenda yinjira mu nzu, amurambikaho ibiganza aramubwira ati “Sawuli mwene Data, Umwami Yesu wakubonekereye mu nzira waturutsemo, arantumye ngo uhumuke wuzuzwe Umwuka Wera.”

18.text: Uwo mwanya ibisa n'imboneranyi bimuva ku maso arahumuka, arahaguruka arabatizwa,

19.text: amaze gufungura abona intege.Amarana iminsi n'abigishwa b'i Damasiko,

20.text: aherako abwiriza mu masinagogi yuko Yesu ari Umwana w'Imana.

21.text: Abamwumvise bose barumirwa bati “Uyu si we warimburiraga i Yerusalemu abāmbaza iryo zina? Kandi icyamuzanye n'ino si ukugira ngo ababohe, abashyīre abatambyi bakuru?”

22.text: Ariko Sawuli arushaho kugwiza imbaraga, atsinda Abayuda batuye i Damasiko arabamwaza, abahamiriza yuko Yesu ari we Kristo.

23.text: Hashize iminsi myinshi Abayuda bajya inama yo kumwica,

24.text: ariko Sawuli amenya inama yabo. Bubikirira ku marembo ku manywa na nijoro, kugira ngo bamwice.

25.text: Abigishwa be ni ko kumujyana nijoro, bamucisha mu nkike z'amabuye, bamumanurira mu gitebo.

26.text: Asohoye i Yerusalemu agerageza kwifatanya n'abigishwa, ariko bose baramutinya ntibemera ko ari umwigishwa.

27.text: Maze Barinaba aramujyana amushyīra intumwa, azisobanurira uko yabonye Umwami Yesu mu nzira, kandi uko yavuganye na we, n'uko yavuze ashize amanga mu izina rya Yesu i Damasiko.

28.text: Abana na bo i Yerusalemu akajya abasura, abwiriza mu izina ry'Umwami ashize amanga,

29.text: akaganira n'Abayuda ba kigiriki ajya impaka na bo, bigeza ubwo na bo bashaka kumwica.

30.text: Ariko bene Data babimenye bamujyana i Kayisariya, bamwohereza i Taruso.

31.text: Nuko Itorero ryose ryari i Yudaya hose n'i Galilaya n'i Samariya rigira amahoro, rirakomezwa kandi rigenda ryubaha Umwami Yesu, rifashwa n'Umwuka Wera riragwira.

32.text: Nuko Petero ajya hose kubasūra, ajya no ku bera batuye i Luda,

33.text: asangayo umugabo witwaga Ayineya wamaze imyaka munani atava ku buriri, kuko yari aremaye.

34.text: Petero aramubwira ati “Ayineya, Yesu Kristo aragukijije, haguruka wisasire.” Uwo mwanya arahaguruka.

35.text: Abatuye i Luda n'i Saroni bose bamubonye bahindukirira Umwami Yesu.

36.text: Kandi i Yopa hari umugore w'umwigishwa witwaga Tabita, risobanurwa ngo “Doruka”. Uwo mugore yagiraga imirimo myiza myinshi n'ubuntu bwinshi.

37.text: Muri iyo minsi ararwara arapfa, bamaze kumwuhagira bamushyira mu cyumba cyo hejuru.

38.text: Kandi kuko i Luda hari bugufi bw'i Yopa, abigishwa bumvise ko Petero ari yo ari, bamutumaho abantu babiri bamwinginga bati “Ngwino uze iwacu, ntutinde.”

39.text: Petero arahaguruka, ajyana na bo. Asohoyeyo bamujyana muri icyo cyumba cyo hejuru, abapfakazi bose bahagarara iruhande rwe barira, berekana amakanzu n'imyenda Doruka yababoheye akiriho.

40.text: Petero abaheza bose, arapfukama arasenga, ahindukirira intumbi ati “Tabita, haguruka.” Arambura amaso, abonye Petero arabyuka aricara.

41.text: Petero amufata ukuboko aramuhagurutsa. Maze ahamagara abera n'abapfakazi, amubaha ari muzima.

42.text: Bimenyekana i Yopa hose, benshi bizera Umwami.

43.text: Nuko amara iminsi myinshi i Yopa, acumbitse kwa Simoni w'umuhazi.
